name: bobie time
source:
Bobie is the local piece of shit in my renpy files.

He bullies and ratios anyone he can. It's your choice to  either tolerate his crap or if you ratio him back.

[From [url=https://yonkbonkers.itch.io/bobietime]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Bobie是我Ren'Py工程里本地的一坨垃圾。

他会欺负人，还会在网上压过别人、让他们下不来台。你可以选择忍受他的胡闹，也可以回敬他，让他也尝尝被人怼的滋味。

[来源：[url=https://yonkbonkers.itch.io/bobietime]Itch.io[/url]]
